_comment: Project-scoped MCP servers for this repository. Three of them; they do
different jobs -- see docs/agents.md for why, and for the walkthrough.
serena: generic symbol operations -- find_symbol, find_referencing_symbols,
rename_symbol, safe_delete_symbol -- over an Elixir language server.
Serena is GPL-3.0+ and is not linked, imported or vendored here; this is a
path handed to a separate published process. bin/serena-mcp starts it,
and puts our Expert build ahead of the version Serena would download.
Two things it needs that are easy to miss: the project must be COMPILED
(.serena/project.yml runs `mix compile` on activation), and cross-file
answers need about ten seconds of indexing after that before they are
right.
ash_agent: the DSL half as an MCP daemon -- the input contract for an
action, the constraints on an attribute, what is declared at a file
position. A language server cannot answer any of those, because Ash
declarations are data in a DSL rather than named symbols.
Start it by hand from the repo root, BEFORE connecting a client:
mix ash_agent.serve --port 4100
It shows as disconnected until a daemon is listening. Compile-only boot
(no Phoenix endpoint, no Oban), loopback-only, POST-only, no auth -- a
dev tool; do not expose it past 127.0.0.1. The entry below names the
daemon's default port (4100) and its actual mount path (the root, not
/mcp). If you override the port -- `--port`, or
`config :ash_agent_tools, :daemon, port: ...` -- change the URL here and
in opencode.json to match. Evidence and transcripts:
docs/evidence/07-daemon-slot.md.
bin/ash-agent remains the non-MCP path to the same tools -- what a shell,
a CI job, or a person uses. .claude/settings.json allowlists it so it
runs without a prompt. Same JSON on stdout either way.
tidewave and ash_ai_dev are deliberately absent. Both attach to a running
dev server, and both are dependencies this demo does not have: it is a
standalone application, not the ash_enterprise reference app. Add them
only if you add the dependencies.
${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.} covers the two ways a client launches a project
server. If yours does neither, replace it with an absolute path.
